implementationNotes: Method notes for the successor, from this session. (1) In this harness zsh does not word-split: 'set -- $r' and 'cmd $A' pass ONE argument. Run poll loops under bash -c; zsh arrays like A=(...) with "${A[@]}" work. (2) A mutation that goes red can still prove nothing: build the mutant from the defect's own shape (see LCLI-573's correction note). (3) lore query with text starting '-' needs flags first and then --. (4) npm view --json wraps its result in a list on this npm. (5) The first publish-release.sh attempt on 0.9.1 died on the report download before any registry write, and a retry succeeded (LCLI-572). (6) Messages sent this session: opum-agent (0.9.1 published; the OPAG-378 measurement and design argument), opum-cli-e2e (0.9.1 for TASK-103), opum-marketplace (v0.9.1 values twice), quest-cli (0.9.1 live), opum-doc (the ODOC-262 per-command correction, which they applied at b1a3dfb).
